description: Open-source video editor rebuilt in pure Rust: multi-track timeline, Lumetri-style colour, scopes, loudness metering and AAF/OTIO interchange
notes: The portable build ships 'portable.txt' beside filmcraft.exe, so FilmCraft keeps its settings, autosave and logs in a 'data' folder next to the executable. Scoop junctions that folder to '$persist_dir\data', so the data survives 'scoop update'.
While that marker is present nothing is written to %APPDATA%\FilmCraft; delete 'portable.txt' in the install directory to go back to the per-user folder.
The first install copies an existing %APPDATA%\FilmCraft into the persist folder, and the pre-uninstall hook mirrors it back as a safety copy; that also runs on 'scoop update'.
The portable zip does not register the file associations that the MSI installer adds.
The app has no built-in updater; use 'scoop update filmcraft' so the install and this manifest stay in sync.
pre_install: abort 'FilmCraft is running, so %APPDATA%\FilmCraft cannot be copied into Scoop persist safely. Quit FilmCraft, then run the install again.'
if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while copying '$legacy' to '$target'; compare the two directories before relying on the new location." } else { info "Copied '$legacy' to '$target'." }
pre_uninstall: warn 'FilmCraft is running, so the state was not mirrored back to %APPDATA%\FilmCraft. Quit it and uninstall again if you want that safety copy.'

if ($code -ge 8) { warn "robocopy exit $code while mirroring '$data' back to '$legacy'." } else { info "Mirrored '$data' back to '$legacy': a plain portable copy or the MSI installer reads that path, while this Scoop install uses the portable marker." }
